defects: The desktop still reads close to opaque; support mounts show through only as small patches.
The broad tabletop has one localized highlight rather than a broad glass reflection.
incumbent_comparison: Better than desk-v003 on glass visibility and source resemblance; current best-so-far candidate, but material realism remains below the promotion threshold.
likely_causes: The saved alpha of 0.78 leaves the surface 78% opaque in the GL Compatibility render.
No reflection probe or environment map contributes a wide window reflection in the current room renderer.
next_action_hypothesis: Reduce top opacity to 0.58 and add a modest Fresnel rim response while keeping the same T-frame geometry. Inspect whether the support and room are more legible through the tinted surface and whether the edge catches a coherent highlight in the production scene.

observations.art_direction_fit: The restrained dark frame and simple shapes fit the stylized room while resembling a modern standing desk.
observations.close_up_quality: Close and profile views retain the T feet and thin tabletop; the surface transparency is visible but subtle.
observations.gameplay_readability: The desk remains readable as the monitor support, and adjacent monitors stay separate in the production scene.
observations.geometric_detail: The top has four separate mounts; columns, full-depth feet, crossbar, edge band, levelers, and control pad remain distinct.
observations.material_realism: The top is darker and shows support mounts through the surface, but still reads mostly as an opaque dark panel with only localized highlights.
observations.proportion: The technical report measured 66 x 29.97 x 30 inches, staying within the brief tolerance and preserving the room envelope.
observations.scale_fidelity: Asset bounds match the 66 x 30 x 30-inch obstacle within 0.03 inches vertically; its surface anchor remains at 30 inches.
observations.semantic_recognizability: The T-frame base and broad desktop read as the standing computer desk in both room and close production views.
observations.silhouette_quality: Two rectangular columns, depth-spanning feet, and a thin top make the photographed desk profile clear.
observations.source_resemblance: The v4 T-frame and smoked top are closer to Sample (2), but the reference shows a more transparent broad glass plane and stronger window reflections.
observations.surface_variation: Glass, edge band, metal columns, feet, and rubber levelers are visibly separated by tone and roughness.
observations.technical_integration: The accepted-override resolver loaded desk-v004, no fallback was used, Godot technical validation passed, and the final detail capture measured 52 FPS.
